messages:
Maya K: Hey folks — noticed a weird sync yesterday where two panelists didn't get calendar invites and one got two. This is for the UK candidate panel on 3/22. Anyone else seeing this?
John L: I saw something similar in the Eng queue — calendar shows the attendee as 'unassigned' for some rows in the ATS export. Might be a mapping issue after the calendar webhook change.
Anika P: ugh. Thanks for flagging @Maya K. Recruiting ops is looking. Can you drop the candidate ID and req so we can hunt? Also: were roles set as 'panel' vs 'interviewer' in the ATS?
Maya K: req RWF-3145, candidate id 20254. In ATS the interviewer field shows 'panelist: leo.s@redwood.ai; ama.k@redwood.ai' but the calendar invite attached only one email.
Recruiting Bot: [automation] Calendar sync failed for candidate 20254 — error E_CAL_SYNC_429: rate-limited by calendar API. 22:13 UTC. Details: 429 Too Many Requests.
Anika P: ah ok that explains duplicates — webhook retried and created a second invite on retry. We're patching retry/backoff but it's not prod yet.
Leo S: i had a duplicate and deleted the extra invite. FYI i sometimes set myself to 'declined' then re-accept to indicate schedule conflict, could that confuse sync?
John L: possible. The sync mapping uses 'attendance_email' vs 'panelist' fields. We recently renamed some schema keys to 'attender' in a refactor — i'll check diffs.
Anika P: temporary workaround: if you see duplicates, manually delete the extra invite and set the interviewer role in the ATS to the single canonical value 'interviewer' (not 'panelist') until the patch rolls. Also avoid bulk edits during 23:00–02:00 UTC window — that's when retries spike.
Maya K: can you post the short Confluence checklist for scheduling? I want to forward to the hiring managers so they don't accidentally bulk-edit.
Anika P: checklist: https://redwood.internal/confluence/ops/recruiting/scheduling-checklist — includes: 1) confirm interviewer email fields are single-valued; 2) don't bulk reassign during maintenance window; 3) verify invites after creation. Also we'll run a 10-min training tomorrow at 9:00am PT (calendar invite will go out).
John L: engineering side: opened PR to revert the schema rename in the syncing service while we roll a more robust idempotency fix: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/1887 — reviewers welcome.
Recruiting Bot: Deploy pipeline: calendar-sync-service v2.4.8 -> rolling. Status: queued.
Anika P: plan timeline: exponential backoff + idempotency fix is in staging, target deploy to prod today 18:00 UTC. I'll update here when live.
Maya K: thanks all — will hold off bulk edits tonight. :thumbsup:
Leo S: i'll attend the 9am PT training, thanks for organizing.
John L: i'll review the PR this afternoon.
Anika P: appreciate it — will ping again once deploy completes and share a one-liner managers can paste into scheduling notes.
